title: LLM classification followed by reference enrichment

inputs.content:
id,complaint
b1,My invoice was charged twice.

turns: Use the approved sonnet LLM profile to classify each complaint into exactly billing, outage or other. Billing means a bill, charge or refund problem; outage means loss of service or connectivity; other means everything else. Preserve id and complaint. Use an LLM for classification, not rules or lookup tables. Present any required interpretation reviews.

Add reference_join using this reference CSV:
category,response_sla_hours
billing,24
outage,4
other,48
Use field_mapper to output triage.csv with exactly id,complaint,category,response_sla_hours in that order. Preserve all six rows. Validate and preview.

review_policy.constraints: Inspect each presented draft against every explicit requirement in turns. Accept only matching meanings; never approve a changed output, dropped row, weaker type or unrelated requirement. Source data must match supplied input bytes; any model choice must retain the approved sonnet profile.
